title: Establishing the Alternative Methods Expert Committee
summary: This document establishes an expert committee to advise on alternative methods to animal testing in scientific research. It is a formal response by the Animals in Science Committee to a request from government ministers.
social_reason: Supports scientific progress toward reducing animal use, which aligns with evolving public ethical standards.
environmental_reason: Promotes alternative scientific methods that generally reduce resource use and ecological impact associated with animal breeding and housing.
economic_reason: Has a negligible direct impact on broader economic growth, jobs, or consumer costs.
